Solution Blueprint Draft

Contoso HR Policy Assistant

A Copilot Studio standard-harness agent in Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot chat that answers Contoso HR policy questions only from the SharePoint "HR Policies" handbook with section citations, refuses out-of-scope topics, and hands personal cases to HR through one Power Automate flow that creates an item in the "HR Requests" list.

Executive Summary

Contoso's HR team receives about 1,200 repetitive policy questions a month by email and Teams, and the answers already exist in the approved HR Policy Handbook. The Contoso HR Policy Assistant answers those questions for ~8,000 employees in Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, strictly from the SharePoint site "HR Policies" (KS-01), citing the handbook section (FR-06), and refuses payroll, other-employee, legal and medical topics (GR-01..GR-04).

Personal decisions and exceptions are handed to HR through one deterministic "Raise HR request" step: the agent collects category, description and urgency (FR-09), a Power Automate flow creates an item in the SharePoint list "HR Requests" (FR-10) and the request ID is returned (FR-11). This is retrieval plus one action — Medium complexity with no need to escalate beyond Stage 1. Route ranking: Standard harness 33/35 > DA + skills 29/35 > GHCP harness 25/35 > Pro-code DA without MCP 18/35 > Pro-code DA with MCP 17/35 > Cowork plugins 16/35 > Scout 14/35.

First-Draft Recommendation

Build on the Standard harness (Copilot Studio) — 33/35, no failed gates. It is a native match for the dominant work types (knowledge retrieval for FR-01..FR-07 and deterministic execution for FR-08..FR-11), it is the platform the source names as target with licensing and environment confirmed (AD-01), and the IT Collaboration team already owns its governance plane (§9).

Hybrid composition: Standard harness for FR-01..FR-08, FR-12, GR-01..GR-06 + Power Automate flow for FR-09..FR-11 writing to SharePoint list "HR Requests". Greeting/suggested prompts (FR-12) and feedback/telemetry (FR-13, NFR-04) are configuration, not AI.

Runner-up: DA + skills (29/35) is a good fit for the cited Q&A but scores lower on integration readiness for the write-back action and on per-user availability (verify in tenant). GHCP harness and both pro-code routes are over-engineered for current scope; Cowork plugins and Scout fail the availability and ownership gates for a company-wide service.

Business Problem and Opportunity

~1,200 repetitive questions a month divert HR capacity from cases needing judgement, delay replies that could be immediate and produce inconsistent answers (§1). Opportunity: resolve 70% without HR within 3 months (SM-01), CSAT ≥ 4/5 (SM-02) and halve HR email volume (SM-03).

In-Scope and Out-of-Scope Capabilities

In scopeOut of scope
Policy questions on leave, work from home, travel and expenses, public holidays (FR-01..FR-04); raising HR requests for personal decisions, exceptions and out-of-scope questions (FR-08..FR-11); answer feedback (FR-13); English only (NFR-07)Payroll and individual salary details (GR-01); other employees' data (GR-02); legal (GR-03) or medical advice (GR-04); any answer not grounded in KS-01 (GR-05, GR-06); any extra knowledge source without business-owner approval (DATA-01)

Current State / Trigger Context

Employees email or message HR in Teams; HR answers by hand from the handbook, with variable wording and completeness (§1). There is no tracked intake for personal cases described in the source.

Target Experience / Future State

Employee signs in once (Entra ID SSO), sees a greeting and 3 suggested prompts, gets a cited answer in under 5 s (NFR-01), is asked to clarify ambiguous questions, and can raise a tracked HR request that returns an ID — all in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot chat.

Primary journey sequence

  1. Employee → Teams / M365 Copilot chat: Opens the agent (SSO via Entra ID)
  2. Copilot Studio agent → Employee: Greeting + 3 suggested prompts (FR-12)
  3. Employee → Copilot Studio agent: "How many days do I get?"
  4. Copilot Studio agent → Employee: Clarifying question: which leave type? (FR-07)
  5. Employee → Copilot Studio agent: "Annual leave — can I carry forward 15 days?"
  6. Copilot Studio agent → SharePoint "HR Policies" (KS-01): Retrieve handbook A1 (FR-05)
  7. Copilot Studio agent → Employee: Up to 10 days carry forward; cites "Handbook A1 Annual leave" (FR-06)
  8. Employee → Copilot Studio agent: Asks for an exception
  9. Copilot Studio agent → Employee: Offers "Raise HR request" (FR-08)
  10. Copilot Studio agent → Employee: Collects category, description, urgency (FR-09)
  11. Copilot Studio agent → Power Automate flow: Submit 3 fields + requester from Entra ID (SEC-01)
  12. Power Automate flow → SharePoint list "HR Requests": Create item (FR-10)
  13. SharePoint list "HR Requests" → Power Automate flow: Item ID
  14. Power Automate flow → Copilot Studio agent: Request ID
  15. Copilot Studio agent → Employee: Shows request ID (FR-11) + feedback option (FR-13)
  16. Copilot Studio agent → Analytics: Usage / deflection / feedback telemetry (NFR-04)

p95 latency above 5 s (NFR-01).Measure in pilot; keep a single, well-structured knowledge source.

Key Technical Decisions

ProposedPrimary platform: Copilot Studio standard harness, published to Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot chat (UX-01).
ProposedKnowledge restricted to KS-01 (SharePoint site "HR Policies"); general web knowledge disabled (GR-05, DATA-01).
Proposed"Raise HR request" is a deterministic topic: collect category, description, urgency (FR-09), then a Power Automate flow creates the list item and returns the ID (FR-10, FR-11). The model never decides whether a request is submitted.
ProposedRequester identity taken from the Entra ID SSO context, never asked (SEC-01, NFR-06).
ProposedGreeting and 3 suggested prompts are fixed configuration, not generated (FR-12).
